links.outcome: Adenoma and sessile serrated lesion detection rates before vs after CADe implementation
links.effect: ADR rose from 31.5% baseline by +7.6% (95% CI 4.6-10.6); SSLDR from 1.3% by +2.9% (95% CI 1.9-3.8); aOR 1.29 for adenoma, 3.10 for SSL detection
links.quote: After adjusting for other covariates (age, gender, BBPS, withdrawal time, positive fecal immunochemical test indication), the odds of adenoma detection (aOR 1.29, 95% CI 1.12-1.51, p = 0.001) and sessile serrated lesion detection (aOR 3.10, 95% CI 1.93-4.99, p < 0.001) were higher after CADe implementation.

unlisted_practices: Pragmatic non-mandated CADe implementation in a trainee-dominated academic county hospital

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world clinical implementation and outcome effects of a CADe device for colonoscopy in an academic county hospital, comparing pre- and post-implementation detection rates rather than testing a specific deployment practice/safeguard variation.
